inclusions.text: Seven nights at the Mercure Luxor Karnak Hotel
inclusions.source: Seven nights at the Mercure Luxor Karnak Hotel, private air-conditioned transfers, daily breakfast and dinner combining Egyptian and international cuisine, dedicated guest-relations support, flexible access to curated guided tours of Luxor's monuments scheduled around your own time, expert English-speaking guides on every tour, and all entrance fees included upfront with no additional charges at the site — these are the operating mechanics.
